records.title: SkillForge: Evolving Verifiable Skills for Reinforcement Learning Agents
records.reason: Primary abstract proposes verification and refinement of skills for RL-trained agents; its contribution is agent training/skill quality, not inference-time efficiency.

records.title: FCPRAG: Fusion-Controller Parametric Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Stable Multi-Passage LoRA Injection
records.reason: Primary abstract proposes retrieval-conditioned LoRA adapter fusion for RAG answer quality and tuning robustness; it does not claim inference/serving efficiency improvements.

records.title: Remember, Verify, or Ask? Cross-Family Evaluation of Memory Commitment in LLM Agents
records.reason: Primary abstract benchmarks whether agents should persist, verify, or clarify memories; the contribution is memory-decision evaluation, not runtime efficiency.

records.title: Multi-turn Conversational AI from Text to Multimodal Interaction: Data, Models, Evaluation, and Open Challenges
records.reason: Primary abstract is a broad multimodal conversational-AI survey/research agenda, with no specific inference/serving efficiency contribution.

records.title: LycheeMemory V2: Efficient Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents via Semantic Segment-Level Consolidation
records.reason: The measured savings are chiefly memory-construction cost, not request-serving inference latency/throughput, and the paper explicitly leaves deployment evaluation open. Fit to the inference/serving scope is therefore uncertain.
